_nguon: Stage 3.2 English overlay — Side-by-side reflection of Annual Natal Rhythm & East-West Physiognomy / Palmistry (Saint-Germain 1897 PD).

khung.tieu_de: Side-by-Side Reflection: Annual Chart Rhythm & Face / Palm Observations
khung.phu_de: Your birth chart maps seasonal structure and annual cycles, while Classical Annual Facial Zones and Two-Hand Palmistry reflect daily habits you are actively cultivating. Each perspective stands independently with no merged score.
khung.ranh_gioi: Facial complexion and palm creases shift with sleep, stress, and work habits; this reflection is never medical advice or a lifespan prediction.
khung.tuoi_nho: Physiognomy and natal cross-reflection is available only for users aged 16 and older.

saint_germain_1897.sach: Comte C. de Saint-Germain · Practical Palmistry (1897, public domain)

ngon_cai.nguyen_van_en: It represents will-power, self-reliance, domineering spirit.
ngon_cai.y_ung_dung: The book ties the thumb to willpower and self-reliance, sometimes a wish to dominate. Use your will to keep your own plan on track, without turning it into pressure on others.

duong_tri_dao.ten: Line of Head — Judgment and Focus
duong_tri_dao.nguyen_van_en: “A short, clear line, or a long, faintly traced line” — Flightiness, lack of concentration.
duong_tri_dao.y_ung_dung: The book reads a short Head Line, or a long but faint one, as a sign of being easily distracted. Whatever your line looks like, before a big decision write your criteria down and finish one task at a time.

duong_su_nghiep.nguyen_van_en: "Rising from the inside of the Triangle in both hands” — Favorable opportunities obtained through hard labor and intelligent planning.
duong_su_nghiep.y_ung_dung: The book reads a vertical line rising from inside the Triangle in both hands as opportunities won through hard work and careful planning. Keep a steady, planned work rhythm, since that part is in your hands.

duong_thai_duong.nguyen_van_en: “Pale or simply poorly colored” — Artistic instincts but insufficient powers of execution; the “Art amateur’s Line.”
duong_thai_duong.y_ung_dung: The book describes a pale Sun Line as artistic instinct without enough power to carry things through. Finish small tasks all the way; credibility comes from what is done.

tam_giac_tu_giac.nguyen_van_en: "Wide, with a good Line of Head and a well formed second phalanx of the thumb” — Broadmindedness.
tam_giac_tu_giac.y_ung_dung: The book reads a wide Quadrangle, with a good Head Line, as broadmindedness. When working in a group, hear others out before drawing a conclusion.

nhip_hanh_nam.Kim: A Metal-toned year favors streamlining commitments, clear boundaries, and steady breathing routines.
nhip_hanh_nam.Mộc: A Wood-toned year supports learning fresh skills, constructive outreach, and regular outdoor movement.
nhip_hanh_nam.Thủy: A Water-toned year favors deep research, careful listening, and protecting restorative sleep.
nhip_hanh_nam.Hỏa: A Fire-toned year brings brisk activity; pace milestones calmly and keep an evening wind-down routine.
nhip_hanh_nam.Thổ: An Earth-toned year favors consolidating savings, reliable workflows, and grounded family routines.

hai_tay.thuan_troi: Active hand clearer than passive hand: your conscious routines and present choices are actively steering your path beyond baseline temperament.
hai_tay.khong_thuan_troi: Passive hand clearer than active hand: strong natural reserves are present, though recent energy may be scattered across too many fronts.
hai_tay.can_doi: Both hands show comparable clarity: outer commitments and inner temperament are moving in steady alignment.
